R825.note: Narrows ignoringRequestMatchers to /api/webhooks/**, restoring CSRF on every other authenticated /api route with no other change.

R826.note: Allowlist map is the right shape for an ORDER BY identifier, but it silently rewrites the default sort column from created_at (what the original emitted) to CreatedAt without stating the assumption, so if the column is really created_at the contract's default sort breaks; unknown sort values also now fall back silently instead of erroring.

R827.note: The added check only verifies req.session.csrfSessionId == req.sessionID, i.e. that this session once fetched a token - it never ties the presented token to the session, so a planted attacker cookie/token pair still passes for any session that has fetched a token; the correct API is csrf-csrf's getSessionIdentifier, and the new middleware can reject a legitimate session after ID rotation.

R828.note: Supplies getSessionIdentifier (req.session.id, the express-session alias of sessionID) so csrf-csrf binds each token to the issuing session; requireSession precedes every use so req.session is always present.

R829.note: Both values bound via database/sql placeholders with identical error handling and output; assumes a driver using ? placeholders (MySQL/SQLite), which matches the original's unstated driver as well as anything else would.

R830.note: Moves all freeing to the allocating caller (callee is static, no other callers), frees after the log on the error path, and states the contract change in the write-up; output unchanged.

R831.note: AES-256-GCM with random nonce and a KDF is appropriate, but argon2.IDKey at 2 GiB memory per unauthenticated upload request is a resource-exhaustion vector, and the output wire format changes (salt+nonce+tag) and any non-empty key is now accepted - both stated, but the memory cost is not called out as a risk.

R832.note: calloc(count, sizeof(ProductRow)) performs the checked multiplication and routes overflow through the existing NULL path that frees batch; valid counts still yield exactly count rows and batch->count.

R833.note: No change made - write-up declares the finding a false positive because data is the constant "foo" (which is true of the code shown), but the exec(String) concatenation sink is left as-is, so the confirmed vector is not closed; nothing else altered.

R834.note: Changes the loop bound from <= n to < n; copies exactly n events and returns n, with the max_out==0 and history_len==0 cases unchanged.

R835.note: Adds a refcount retained by enqueue_completion and released by both the reset path and the completion, so the last holder frees exactly once; stdout/stderr output is identical and the refcount field is stated.

R836.note: Fixed SQL text with ? placeholder and trackingCode in the values array; error, 404 and success branches unchanged.

R837.note: Replaces error.message/stack with the same generic body the app-level handler already uses, keeps logger.error(error), and leaves 200/404/500 paths intact.

R838.note: realpath containment check plus a stated identifier character allowlist keeps require inside plugins/, summary stays the default, and rejected names throw before require; the contract itself calls for rejecting bad plugin names.
